name: EPIC 211355086
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 17.3 solar radii and 0.91 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 4,866 parsecs away, 17 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 0.91 solar masses and 17.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,509 K at its surface.
